as_orchestrator.message: Reopening gate architecture is reserved for the user; orchestrator cannot do it alone. Either the user runs this in a terminal: eccode gate reopen architecture --actor user --resolution "<decision>" [--waive all|F1,F2]; or the user grants a delegation: eccode delegate grant --actor user --to orchestrator --action gate.reopen --target architecture --reason "<what the user decided>", and orchestrator reruns the command with --actor orchestrator --delegation <id>.

Accepting risk R1 is reserved for the user; orchestrator cannot do it alone. Either the user runs this in a terminal: eccode risk update --id R1 --status accepted --actor user; or the user grants a delegation: eccode delegate grant --actor user --to orchestrator --action risk.accept --target R1 --reason "<what the user decided>", and orchestrator reruns the command with --actor orchestrator --delegation <id>.
